subject: Updated Benchmarks including new ADA series GPUs

messages.author: Ross Walker
messages.body:
Hi All,
For those who are interested I just finished benchmarking Amber 22 with the latest ADA series GPUs from NVIDIA. A newly updated set of benchmark results covering the majority of GPU models currently available from NVIDIA is available here:
https://www.exxactcorp.com/blog/Molecular-Dynamics/RTX3090-Benchmarks-for-HPC-AMBER22-A100-vs-RTX3080-vs-RTX3070-vs-RTX6000
All the best
Ross
